verdict.rationale: The closest first-party evidence is Runway Ads: it publishes generated ads to Meta, Google and TikTok, then "builds the next round around what earned spend." That is AI acting on the user's own performance data, backed by a thin "Agentic creative collaborator" claim. Nothing documents surfacing explicit insights, analytics summaries or recommendations to the user. missing for 10: documented in-product AI insights or suggestions derived from user data, detail on how the Ads performance feedback is presented to users, the agentic collaborator's data-driven suggestion behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
